title: Top CT Scan Centres in Bangalore |High-Quality Services
author: john25
contentHtml:
Introduction

Bangalore, India’s Silicon Valley, is home to some of the most advanced healthcare facilities in the country. With a rising demand for precise diagnostic imaging, CT scan centres in Bangalore have evolved to offer cutting-edge technology, expert radiologists, and quick results. Whether you need a routine scan or specialized imaging, choosing the right centre is crucial for accurate diagnosis.

This guide explores the best CT scan centres in Bangalore, their features, pricing, and what to look for when selecting a diagnostic facility.

Why Choose a CT Scan?

A Computed Tomography (CT) scan is a non-invasive imaging procedure that uses X-rays to create detailed cross-sectional images of the body. It helps diagnose:

  • Trauma injuries (fractures, internal bleeding)

  • Tumors and cancers

  • Heart and vascular diseases

  • Infections and inflammations

  • Neurological conditions (stroke, brain tumors)

CT scans are faster and more detailed than traditional X-rays, making them a preferred choice for emergency and complex cases.

Top CT Scan Centres in Bangalore

1. Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road

  • Technology: 128-slice CT scanner

  • Specializations: Cardiac, neurological, and oncology imaging

  • Pricing: ₹3,500 – ₹12,000

  • Why Choose? NABL-accredited, expert radiologists, quick reports

2. Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport Road

  • Technology: Dual-source CT scanner

  • Specializations: Lung, abdominal, and vascular imaging

  • Pricing: ₹4,000 – ₹15,000

  • Why Choose? Advanced 3D imaging, minimal radiation exposure

3. Fortis Hospital, Cunningham Road

  • Technology: 64-slice CT scanner

  • Specializations: Trauma, orthopedic, and pediatric imaging

  • Pricing: ₹3,200 – ₹10,000

  • Why Choose? Emergency CT services, AI-assisted diagnostics

4. Aster CMI Hospital, Hebbal

  • Technology: High-resolution CT scanner

  • Specializations: Brain, spine, and ENT imaging

  • Pricing: ₹3,800 – ₹11,500

  • Why Choose? Same-day reports, affordable packages

5. Sparsh Hospital, Yeshwanthpur

  • Technology: 256-slice CT scanner

  • Specializations: Cardiac and whole-body scans

  • Pricing: ₹4,500 – ₹16,000

  • Why Choose? Low-dose radiation, pediatric-friendly

Factors to Consider When Choosing a CT Scan Centre

1. Accreditation & Certification

Ensure the centre is NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories) or NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) certified for quality assurance.

2. Advanced Technology

Look for multi-slice CT scanners (64-slice, 128-slice, or 256-slice) for higher precision and faster results.

3. Radiologist Expertise

Choose centres with experienced radiologists specializing in neurology, cardiology, or oncology for accurate interpretations.

4. Pricing & Insurance

  • Average cost: ₹3,000 – ₹15,000 (varies based on body part and scan type)

  • Insurance coverage: Check if the centre accepts Ayushman Bharat, MediAssist, or private insurers.

5. Turnaround Time

Some centres provide same-day reports, while others may take 24-48 hours.

6. Safety & Radiation Levels

Opt for low-dose CT scans to minimize radiation exposure, especially for children and frequent scans.

How to Book a CT Scan in Bangalore?

  1. Online Booking: Most hospitals (Apollo, Manipal) allow appointments via their websites.

  2. Diagnostic Chains: Labs like Metropolis, Thyrocare, and Dr. Lal PathLabs offer home collection and discounts.

  3. Walk-in Appointments: Available at standalone imaging centres.

Affordable CT Scan Centres in Bangalore

  • Medall Diagnostics (₹3,000 – ₹9,000)

  • Agadi Diagnostics (₹3,200 – ₹8,500)

  2. Diagnostic Chains: Labs like Metropolis, Thyrocare, and Dr. Lal PathLabs offer home collection and discounts.

Conclusion

Choosing the right CT scan centre in Bangalore depends on technology, expertise, cost, and convenience. Leading hospitals like Apollo, Manipal, and Fortis provide high-quality imaging with quick results, while diagnostic chains offer affordable options.

Before booking, verify accreditation, compare prices, and check insurance coverage for a hassle-free experience.
